title: MSCE mobilization for public-sector budget, wage recovery and state enterprise defense
location: Plaza Independencia, Montevideo, followed by a march to the Ministry of Economy and Finance.
scope: One national MSCE action; source says delegations from around Uruguay backed the claims, but only the Montevideo gathering location is established.
organizer: Mesa Sindical Coordinadora de Entes (MSCE), within PIT-CNT

state_target.target: Uruguayan government/public-sector demands included staffing, public investment, wage recovery and public enterprise defense.
state_target.evidence: Uruguayan government/public-sector demands included staffing, public investment, wage recovery and public enterprise defense.

demands_original: Unions demanded staffing, end to outsourcing, real-wage recovery, public investment and larger sector budget; challenge to state policy and public enterprises.
participants_original: No estimate of the number present at Plaza Independencia. National strike participants/delegations are not a local gathering count.
threshold_50_evidence: Actual concentration and march are documented; no simultaneous attendance number establishes 50 at the one site.

start_date.summary: Source supports start date 2025-07-23 at day precision.
